spotlights.title: FAST+ · one approval and evidence rail
spotlights.description: Built for FP&A Commercial's FCF control attestation across 14 markets. The same rail can carry every tower's control sign-offs, with AI checking evidence and summarising the approval pack.

opportunities.title: Pre-submit evidence completeness check
opportunities.description: FAST+ checks required files, period, market and approver fields before the request enters the workflow and returns specific missing-item messages.

opportunities.title: AI prediction of approval bottlenecks
opportunities.description: Historical cycle times and workflow patterns flag requests likely to miss the cut-off so delegation or follow-up can happen earlier.

opportunities.title: AI approval summary
opportunities.description: AI summarises the approval pack, key evidence and exceptions so approvers can review the important points quickly.

opportunities.title: Approval record capture
opportunities.description: A consistent approval record keeps the decision, approver and supporting evidence together for later traceability.

opportunities.title: OneGRC evidence pack
opportunities.description: Approved evidence is organised into a reusable control pack for governance and audit support.

opportunities.title: Control-status visibility
opportunities.description: A common status view shows which controls are complete, pending or require follow-up.

opportunities.title: Control sign-off workflow
opportunities.description: Standard sign-off steps reduce different approval approaches across towers and markets.

opportunities.title: Reusable approval rail
opportunities.description: The FAST+ pattern becomes a common approval and evidence rail that other towers can reuse rather than build separately.

opportunities.title: Cross-tower control reuse
opportunities.description: The same evidence-check, summary and sign-off pattern can support control activities wherever equivalent approvals are required.

spotlights.title: One automation platform for reconciliations
spotlights.description: The BSR automation framework built for P2P (governed VM, script repository, run dashboard, BlackLine API) is reused for O2C bank reconciliations, R2R, Controlling and Tax instead of each tower building its own.

opportunities.title: P2P BSR automation framework
opportunities.description: The governed P2P reconciliation framework becomes the reusable base instead of each tower creating a separate automation stack.

opportunities.title: O2C bank reconciliation
opportunities.description: O2C reuses the common extraction, template and automated reconciliation pattern for bank reconciliation work.

opportunities.title: R2R reconciliation reuse
opportunities.description: R2R applies the shared framework to reconciliation activities during close.

opportunities.title: Controlling reconciliation reuse
opportunities.description: Controlling uses the same governed reconciliation components and run approach.

opportunities.title: Tax reconciliation reuse
opportunities.description: Tax reuses the common reconciliation framework where tax balance checks require the same pattern.

opportunities.title: Scheduled SAP extraction
opportunities.description: Scheduled extraction removes repeated manual data pulls and provides a consistent input to reconciliation runs.

opportunities.title: Standard reconciliation template
opportunities.description: A common template standardises the structure of reconciliation inputs and outputs across participating towers.

opportunities.title: Automated anomaly flags
opportunities.description: Automated checks highlight unmatched or unusual items so teams can focus on exceptions.

opportunities.title: BlackLine API upload
opportunities.description: Completed reconciliation outputs are passed into BlackLine through the shared integration pattern.

spotlights.title: WHT and VAT decided at invoice capture
spotlights.description: An AI determination assistant classifies the payment nature and proposes the WHT code and VAT treatment when the invoice arrives in P2P, so Tax reviews exceptions instead of correcting postings at month end.

opportunities.title: Vendor tax-profile check
opportunities.description: The invoice is checked against the vendor tax profile before downstream posting decisions are made.

opportunities.title: Payment-nature classification
opportunities.description: AI classifies the nature of the payment from invoice information to support the correct tax treatment.

opportunities.title: WHT code proposal
opportunities.description: The assistant proposes the relevant withholding-tax code at invoice capture for review.

opportunities.title: VAT treatment proposal
opportunities.description: VAT treatment is proposed while the invoice is being processed rather than corrected later.

opportunities.title: Tax exception routing
opportunities.description: Cases that do not meet the standard rules are routed to Tax for review.

opportunities.title: Clean P2P posting
opportunities.description: Validated tax treatment supports a cleaner downstream posting from P2P.

opportunities.title: Invoice-capture validation
opportunities.description: Tax-related checks are brought forward to the point where invoice data first enters the process.

opportunities.title: Tax-rule decision support
opportunities.description: The assistant applies the relevant decision logic to help users select the appropriate treatment.

opportunities.title: Exception-only Tax review
opportunities.description: Tax focuses on exceptions rather than manually reviewing every routine transaction.

opportunities.title: Reduce month-end corrections
opportunities.description: Earlier validation reduces the need to correct tax-related postings during month-end close.

opportunities.title: P2P and Tax integration
opportunities.description: The opportunity connects invoice processing and tax review so the decision is made closer to source.
